lines: An A-I is legally allowed to diagnose you — with no doctor in the room.
That's not coming. It's been true since twenty-eighteen.
The F-D-A cleared a system to catch diabetic eye disease on its own. No clinician reads the scan.
Nine hundred patients, ten ordinary clinics. Eighty-seven percent sensitivity, ninety-one percent specificity.
But read what it's cleared FOR. Screening. Never treatment.
A-I can screen you. Only a doctor can treat you.
Use it as a second opinion — never the last one.
